Name: Aegis-X
Text:
All Ships with this rule in a Group in coherency combine their X values into a single value Y.
Friendly Groups in coherency within 6" of a Ship with this rule and the same Orbital Layer (including its own Group) gain the benefits of Aegis.
When rolling saves against Close Action and Bomber (of any type) attacks, those Groups gain Y additional save dice they may add to their Energy or Kinetic saves. Before rolling to save, the defending player assigns these dice against specific weapons, divided up as they choose (including any modified hits) between any Energy or Kinetic saves.
An Aegis Group can only grant the benefits of Aegis once each time a friendly group is attacked.
A friendly Group can only benefit from Aegis from one Group each time it is attacked.
Aegis has no effect on Backup saves or saves that replace Energy and Kinetic saves (such as Shield saves)."
In addition, Ships benefiting from Aegis increase the number of bombers required to trigger Saturation Fire by Y.
Example: A Ship benefiting from Aegis-2 would suffer one Core hit per bomber above 8, rather than 6."

Name: Cloak-X
Text: This Group may have a maximum of X Spikes.

Name: Command Ship-X
Text: Increase the Level of any Admiral assigned to this Ship by X.

Name: Descent
Text: This special rule confers various benefits covered in the core rules.

Name: Detector
Text: If this Ship is on an order that allows it to attack, this Ship may forgo one allowed Weapon use during its activation. If it does, at the end of its activation place two Spikes on an enemy Group in line of sight. A Group that uses Detector gains a Spike (regardless of the amount of Ships using this rule).
Example: A Ship with 1 Weapon and Detector on General Quarters would be able to either attack with its single Weapon or use its Detector rule.

Name: Escort
Text: At the start of the game, before deployment, assign this Group to escort a friendly Group of H or C Tonnage. An Escort Group and its escorted Group are a pair, no other Groups can be part of this pair. Until either Group is destroyed, the pair activate and perform their actions (moving, turning, attacking, etc) simultaneously and count as a single Group when generating pass tokens. The pair do not need to choose the same Order when they activate. Escort Groups are deployed alongside their escorted Group, ignoring tonnage restrictions for the Escort Group. The pair do not need to be in coherency, however while both Groups are within 6" of each other they ignore Saturation Fire from enemy Bombers

Name: Gateship-X
Text:
Shaltari Motherships must launch their Dropships via a Ship/Dropsite with this rule (sometimes referred to as Gateships). Each Gateship can have up to X Dropships deployed from it each round. Note: though the launch is measured from the Gateship, it is the Mothership that is launching.
When this Ship goes on the Max Thrust or Damage Control orders, it reduces its Gateship-X value to 0 until the start of its next activation.

Name: Marines-X
Text: Remove X enemy Battalions from this Ship at the beginning of the Battalion Combat step.

Name: Monitor
Text: Ships with this rule may not use Course Change or Max Thrust orders.

Name: Mothership
Text:
Shaltari Motherships can only deploy their Dropships via friendly Ships or controlled Dropsites with the Gateship-X special rule (sometimes referred to as Gateships).
These Gateships must be within 18" of the Mothership or part of a chain of Gateships with each Gateship in the chain being within 18" of another. Note: though the launch is measured from the Gateship, it is the Mothership that is launching.

Name: Payload S/L-X
Text:
When building your fleet, you may choose as many Payload Ships as you like—tonnage limits do not apply to these Ships, and they have no Group size. All Payload S/L Ships must be assigned to a Porter S/L Ship with the same letter. Payload Ships may not activate or be targeted until detached.
Payload Ships take up X of a Porter Ship's capacity.
During the Porter Ship's activation, if it is on an Order that allows it to Launch, you may detach one or more of its Payload Ships and place them within 3" of it. In the round they are detached, these Payloads activate together immediately as part of the Porter Ship's activation after it has completed its Order. In subsequent rounds, all your Payload Ships count as being part of a single Group. Crippling Effects, Spikes, and other rules that affect an entire Group only affect the targeted Payload Ship.
Payload Ships always follow General Quarters Orders, even if its Porter is on different Orders. Payload Ships ignore Coherency rules (and do not gain Formation Benefits), have no Lead Ship, are targeted by attacks individually, and these attacks can only damage the targeted Payload Ship.
If a Payload Ship is attached to a Porter Ship when that Ship is destroyed, the Payload Ship is destroyed.

Name: Porter S/L-X
Text:
This Ship may be assigned Payload Ships with the same letter up to a total capacity of X."
During a Porter's activation, it may attach any detached Payload Ships within 3" if it has available capacity. Payload Ships reattached to a Porter Ship are removed from the table to be deployed in a later round.
Any tokens, Spikes, or effects affecting the reattached Payload Ship are removed from that Ship.

Name: Rapid Drop
Text: This Ship may launch its Assets at any point during its movement.

Name: Rare
Text: You may only take one Group of this Ship in a Skirmish-sized game, two in a Clash, three in a Battle, and four in a Reconquest.

Name: Regenerate-X
Text: This Ship recovers X lost Hull Points at the end of its activation.

Name: Shield-X
Text:
This Group/Dropsite has an unmodifiable Shield save of X+.
At the start of this Group's or controlled Dropsite's activation, you may choose to raise its shields. If you do, this group gains a shields token until the start of its next activation.
While a Group/Dropsite has a shields token, it replaces its Energy and Kinetic saves with its Shield save and triples its Signature value (before Spikes). Shield saves are used against all hits from weapons before making Backup saves. Shield saves must be used before making Backup saves against Core hits. After being attacked, a Group with a shields token gains a Spike.
A Group on Silent Running loses any shields tokens it has and cannot have shields tokens.
Groups that Directly Deploy may start the game with a shields token.
Core Hits caused by Boarding Actions and Saturation Fire cannot be saved by Shield Saves.

Name: Stealth
Text: This Ship may fire one Weapon while Silent Running.

Name: Unique
Text: You may only take one Group of this Ship.

Name: Vectored
Text: This Ship may make an additional turn, up to 45 degrees, at any point during its movement, regardless of the Order its Group has taken.

Name: Impetuous
Text: At the start of each round, friendly Groups with this rule improve the Lock of their Weapon Systems by 1 until you activate a friendly Group without this rule.

Name: Reinforced Armour
Text: Weapons rolling to hit this Ship or its Group can only score criticals against it on a result of a 3 higher than its Lock value.

Name: Vanguard-X"
Text: Groups with this rule may begin the game Directly Deployed, ignoring the normal Scenario Deployment and Approach Types (though still counting towards Groups Directly Deployed). If it does, it may be deployed up to X" away from your Deployment Zone.

Name: Hero
Text: You can only include two Groups with this special rule in your fleet. You cannot assign an Admiral to this Ship when building your fleet.

Name: Boardable
Text:
This Ship can have Battalions Assigned to it as if it were a Space Station.
At the start of the round, this Ship is controlled by a Player if only they have any Battalions on it, lasting until the end of the round.
Players that control a Boardable Ship may activate it as if it were a Ship in their Fleet, after all other Groups have activated.

Name: Civilian Transport
Text:
This Ship can only choose the General Quarters order.
This Ship cannot be attacked unless it is controlled by a player. Players cannot attack a friendly Civilian Transport.
The Controlling player cannot target this Ship with Abilities.

Name: Mercenary (X)
Text: This Ship may be used in X faction Fleets. When taken as part of your fleet, this Ship loses its Boardable and Civilian Transport rules.
